conventions.summary: arcade driving of the sedan on its own carriageway (SCENE-TASK 'Driving the sedan'); BEHAVIOUR.md specifies the model
conventions.units: metres, seconds, m/s and m/s^2; angles in degrees; pairs written [a, b] run from standstill (a) to topSpeed (b)
conventions.heading: the car's heading is its lane direction turned by a heading offset of at most steer.headingDeg; the offset follows the steering input at steer.rateDegPerSecond (scaled down below steer.fullRateSpeed) and returns to zero when the input is released
conventions.route: the car drives the route (layout.json approaches; BEHAVIOUR.md 'Approach roads'): its position is a route station and a lateral offset, which are the scene Z and X on the deck; start.z is a station on the deck
conventions.carriageway: the car stays between the median and the curb of its direction; at either edge it bumps (keeps curb.speedKept of its speed, at most once per curb.cooldown seconds) and its heading offset relaxes
conventions.traffic: the car never overlaps a traffic vehicle: it brakes for the one ahead in its lateral span to keep traffic.minGap, and cannot move sideways into one (margins traffic.lateralMargin and traffic.longitudinalMargin); traffic brakes for the car
conventions.roadEnd: the car's road ends at each approach's ends.car station (layout.json; fix round 2 moved it from the deck ends onto the approach roads, traffic drives on to the approach ends); within roadEnd.promptDistance of it a turn-around prompt shows; the car stops roadEnd.stopDistance before it; holding the throttle against that stop, or holding reverse at rest within promptDistance (reverse does not engage there), for roadEnd.holdSeconds turns the car around, as does the turn-around key; turning around fades to black, moves the car to the mirror position on the opposite carriageway facing the other way, at rest, and fades back
conventions.controls: keyboard codes (KeyboardEvent.code); throttle, reverse, left and right are the kit's movement axes; Shift holds forward boost; on touch the throttle joystick accelerates forward, brakes then reverses backward, and steers sideways, with separate held Boost and Brake buttons
conventions.paint: the driven sedan's colour, a name from traffic.json palette
